title: Finish RA daemon cutover quarantine and legacy removal
description: Follow-on work after the daemon cutover: internalize daemon-only surfaces, migrate remaining legacy eager-runtime tests/tools, and remove the last public direct-runtime escape hatches.
design: Supported query execution must remain daemon-backed only. Legacy eager runtime stays explicitly quarantined until all remaining internal users are migrated or deleted.
acceptance_criteria: Remaining public/product surfaces no longer expose direct runtime execution; legacy runtime lives behind an explicit internal namespace/module only; remaining legacy tests and harnesses are either migrated or intentionally isolated with an explicit removal path.

title: Restore RA-backed stdlib primitive families
description: Rebuild the remaining stdlib extern surface on top of the daemon-backed incremental rust-analyzer runtime, with explicit capability registration and supported-path regression coverage.
design: Keep std.raql source-stable; add provider families under stable extern names; no public fallback to legacy eager snapshot behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Each restored stdlib extern family is served by the supported daemon/runtime path, registered in capability gating, and covered by daemon-path tests.
